alt: A three-tiered yellow cake features intricate, hand-painted botanical designs with green leaves, red berries, and colorful flowers on each level.

A three-tiered wedding cake decorated in red, black, and white features a baseball theme, including a Cortland Red Dragons cap at the base, jersey numbers 6 and 27 on the middle tier, and a bride and groom figurine on top.
This elaborate two-tiered cake is decorated with a painted forest scene, faux moss, rocks, and purple crystal clusters, featuring a central waterfall cascading down the middle tier.
A four-tiered white wedding cake decorated with intricate piped icing and adorned with a cascade of pale pink roses and green leaves.
A tall, sculpted birch tree centerpiece with green leaves and a rocky base decorated with blue flowers sits on a table inside a white tent, accompanied by wooden letters spelling "Love is Sweet."
A four-tiered wedding cake features textured white frosting with sweeping bands of pink and red icing, adorned with cascading gold leaf decorations that spiral from the top tier down to the base.
